card.name: Ending of neuraxial and epidural words
card.fires_on: The last piece of anatomical adjective words such as neuraxial, epidural, caudal and pleural, mostly in anesthesia or bleeding-risk warnings.

modes.label: Neuraxial anesthesia
modes.description: The closing piece of 'neuraxial' before anesthesia or puncture in anticoagulant warnings.

modes.example: for epid<<ural>> anesthesia in obstetrical patients.
